## About
Touch-Up Pro started as a family-owned mobile body shop, and a lot of our scratch and dent work still comes straight to you. We work on everything from cars and trucks to motorhomes, semis, motorcycles, boats and more.
When a job needs the shop, you can drop your vehicle off or have it towed in. We handle small scratches and paint chips up through collision repairs, and we use a computerized color matching system so the new paint blends with the old. We also work with insurance companies to make the claims process easier.
Neighbors around Mesa have given us a 4.9 rating from 362 Google reviews, and we would like to earn yours too.

## Services
- Collision repairs: Repairs that return your vehicle to the condition it was in before the accident.
- Mobile auto body repair: Small to medium body and paint repairs done at your location, so you don't have to bring the car in.
- Paintless dent repair: Dents and dings fixed while keeping your vehicle's original finish.
- Body shop services: Area repaints, touch-ups, scratch and scuff repairs, headlight restoration, torn bumper repairs, sun damage and peeling paint repairs, and color matching.
- RV and motor home repair: Body repairs for bigger vehicles, by techs who know how recreational vehicles are built.
- Fleet management painting: Regular paint maintenance and consistent color matching to keep your business vehicles looking sharp and on-brand.

## FAQ
Q: Are your estimates free?
A: Yes. We give you a free, detailed estimate before any work begins.

Q: Can you come to my home or work?
A: Yes. Our mobile scratch and dent repair service comes to your location.

Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. On collision repairs we work with insurance companies to make your claims process easier.

Q: Do you offer a military or first responder discount?
A: Yes. Military personnel and first responders get 5% off labor. Mention it when you schedule. It can't be combined with other offers, and restrictions apply.
